hotel.name: Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis

verified_facts.text: Hotel Ivy is directly connected to the Minneapolis Skyway system.
verified_facts.excerpt: Directly connected to the city’s Skyway system, Hotel Ivy provides convenient access to the cultural vibrancy of the city’s arts, sports, music, and culinary scene.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set within a historic Art Deco tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within a historic Art Deco tower, this refined retreat features serene accommodations

verified_facts.text: The Ivy Tower was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1986.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ivy Tower was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1986.

verified_facts.text: The Ivy Tower is in the Ziggurat style, a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ziggurat style is identified as a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories.

verified_facts.text: The tower's structure was first commissioned by the Second Church of Christ Scientist.
verified_facts.excerpt: The tower's structure was first commissioned by the Second Church of Christ Scientist

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites feature original artwork, fine linens and limestone bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: each featuring high-speed internet, original artwork, fine linens, and limestone bathrooms

verified_facts.text: All guest rooms have a soaking tub with a separate glass-enclosed shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soaking tub with separate glass-enclosed shower in all guest rooms.

verified_facts.text: High-floor rooms offer 10-foot ceilings, custom abstract art and bar carts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our high-floor rooms offer 10-foot ceilings, custom abstract art and elegant, inviting bar carts

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has a private rooftop balcony and panoramic windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: This penthouse suite offers the city’s most spectacular views from a private rooftop balcony, as well as panoramic windows surrounding the suite’s 1,900-square feet of indoor living space.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Frette linens, a down comforter and a pillow-top mattress.
verified_facts.excerpt: Frette linens, a down comforter, plush pillows and a pillow-top mattress.

verified_facts.text: Anda Spa has a Crystal Sauna and hydrotherapy, and offers massages, advanced facials and nail services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complete with nine treatment rooms, Crystal Sauna, and hydrotherapy, Anda Spa is a luxury hotel spa in Minneapolis offering massages, advanced facials, nail services, and fitness programming

verified_facts.text: Anda Spa draws on crystal-based wellness practices.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anda Spa captures the essence of crystal-based wellness practices by blending holistic influences throughout a gathering place of energy.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Serenity experience is an evening for two with private use of the Quartz spa, an Alchemy Aroma Journey and a full body exfoliation and massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy an intimate evening for two complete with private use of the Quartz spa, an Alchemy Aroma Journey, a full body exfoliation & massage experience and more!

verified_facts.text: The fitness center at Anda Spa features Technogym equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay active in Anda Spa's fitness center featuring our state-of-the-art Technogym

verified_facts.text: Breva is a neighborhood bar and grill serving New American fare and craft cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breva, a neighborhood bar and grill, stands out as a bar in downtown Minneapolis with New American fare, craft cocktails, and seasonal dishes infused with global flavors.

verified_facts.text: Thor Cigar Lounge is an outdoor lounge for premium cigars with food and handcrafted cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thor Cigar Lounge is a sophisticated outdoor retreat where guests can unwind, connect, and savor premium cigars paired with elevated food and handcrafted cocktails

verified_facts.text: The concierge is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our expert Concierge is available 24 hours a day to assist and arrange anything you may need throughout your stay.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Minneapolis pet friendly hotel is located in the heart of the city and welcomes your loyal four-legged companions.

verified_facts.text: The Minnesota Convention Center is connected to Hotel Ivy by climate-controlled skyways.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connected to Hotel Ivy with climate-controlled skyways.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Ivy partners with the Hennepin Theatre Trust to provide access to the Hennepin Avenue cultural district.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Ivy, Minneapolis partners with the Hennepin Theatre Trust to provide access to the thriving Hennepin Avenue cultural district in downtown Minneapolis.

verified_facts.text: The lobby is a study in sharp edges, marble, glass and winter-white fabrics.
verified_facts.excerpt: The cavernous lobby is an elegant study in sharp edges, marble, glass, and winter-white fabrics, which lends it a mid-century modern air.

verified_facts.text: Parking is off-site valet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-site valet parking is available at Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis.

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have electric vehicle charging stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis does not have electric vehicle charging stations.
